recommended_codex_review: Two questions only Codex can settle, both cheap to answer. (1) Is pressing 前往查看 on a power-blocked master bounty an acceptable state to enter? It is a navigation control (the dispatch control is 出征, which is separate), but its effect is unmeasured, and if the answer is yes then this work order becomes a five-minute live run the next time the client happens to be on the board with such a pin. If the answer is no, the honest resolution is to wait for the state to recur naturally -- it has happened at least twice today (09:21Z and 09:56Z) -- and capture the run then, so the order should be re-issued as WAITING_FOR_NATURAL_STATE rather than left READY. (2) Note for the same review: the recovery ends the run when BACK does not move the client (stop_reason SAFE_BACK_NOT_PROVEN, measured in this replay). That is honest and it stops the old permanent dead end, because every following run gets one fresh attempt at the escape; but if BACK is ever permanently ineffective nothing else on this page can move the client. No further action is recommended on current evidence.
REMAINING_ISSUE: One live run from a blocked beast card is still outstanding. Additionally, the once-per-run flag beast_card_not_actionable_left is unreachable in the failing case, because a failed transition ends the run before a second decision is taken; it therefore only guards the second-order case where BACK succeeds and the card reappears inside the same run. That is a deliberate, documented redundancy rather than a defect, but it was measured here rather than assumed.
